introHtml: Hand wash only champagne glasses are ideal for events where you want the elegance of glass without the risk of dishwasher damage. These custom glasses, like our 10 oz Plastic Stemless Champagne Flute, offer a durable yet refined option for toasts at weddings, corporate galas, or New Year celebrations. Choose full-color digital imprinting for vibrant logos that stand out. Keep them gleaming with gentle hand washing.
